notes.title: Patch v.0.1.4.6
notes.notes:
Up to 8 debuffs/buffs in UI will be displayed on the player and target frames. There are no limit for actual number of debuffs/buffs present on the creature.,

Debuff added: Overweight - 'Reduces movement speed when carrying excessive weight'. Reduces movement speed by 30%.,

Debuff added: Heavy Overweight - 'Significantly reduces movement speed and draining stamina when carrying excessive weight'. Reduces movement speed by 50%; Disables Stamina regeneration; Takes 1 SP per tick;,

Debuff added: Criminal - 'Could be targeted by guards in towns or other players looking to enforce justice for crimes he did.' Free to kill target with no penalty loss; Players may call for guards to kill Criminal; Getting +20 Faith every 5 min.,

Debuff added: Murderer - 'Outlaw who was abandoned by the God thus turned to their own dark fate'. Free to kill target with no penalty loss; Innocent NPCs do not talk to Murderer; Reduced Faith gains; Guards kill Murderer on sight.,

Debuffs added: Light bleed/Moderate bleed/Heavy bleed - 'Loosing X amount of HP every 8 seconds'. Depends on the severity, creature losses some amount of HP. Heavier bleeding - more damage and longer duration. Players and some creatures have a chance to apply "... bleed" using melee/range weapons on hit. Higher damage - higher chance.,

Buffs added: Morning Star/Elven Quickdraw/Eagle's Eye/... - multiple existent buffs were moved to the new system with UI representation.,

Debuff added: Stunned - 'Unconscious for short period of time'. Completely disables a creature to move/rotate/attack/cast spells/etc. Could be applied on headshot hits. Higher damage - higher chance (head armor decreases the chance due to lower damage intake).,

Debuff added: Injured - 'Slightly slowing and prevents sprinting, strafing, jumping,...' Prevents a creature from most escape/agility based abilities/skills. Could be applied on hit to legs and feet. Higher damage - higher chance (wearing legs/boot with armor decreases the chance due to lower damage intake).,

Debuff added: Broken Arm - 'Cannot use second hand for parrying and blocking'. Prevents a creature to parry and block attacks using hands. Could be applied on hit to arms and hands. Higher damage - higher chance (wearing gloves and arms armor decreases the chance due to lower damage intake).

notes.title: Patch v.0.1.4.5
notes.notes:
Special bonuses of metal based items.
Unique attributes or bonuses granted to items depending on the metal they are forged from.


 Iron. No bonuses. Heavy and cheap.
 Bronze. Slightly better than Iron (more damage, more armor, same weight, same DEX/INT loss)
 Silver. Reduced stats loss. "Demon Slayer" - does extra damage (as Holy damage) to the Demons. Also Demons touching the Silver armor - gets Holy damage.
 Gold. Reduced stats loss. Increased damage/armor/etc.
 Shadow. Very light plate armor that almost do not reduce stats. Provides less bonuses than other metal of the same tier.
 Blood Rock. Heavy. Highest tier in current version. Top damage/armor. **Chance on hit:** - Life Drain.
 

New player attribute added:  Faith.
Faith represent your loyalty to the God that in world of Arda, named as Eru Ilúvatar. 
Your Faith drops when you do crimes and increases when you do "good" things.


 Faith could be from -10,000 up to +10,000. There is no GUI that represents exact number (on purpose).
Faith from 0 to 10,000 represents an innocent player.  Innocent players have their nicknames highlighted with blue color. 
 Faith from -1000 up to 0 represents a criminal player. Criminals nicknames highlighted with gray color.
 Criminal (gray) players constantly getting gains of Faith every few minutes until they justified back to Innocent (blue) Faith levels. Takes from 5 min to 2 hours for full recovery.
 Player who hit an innocent (like hitting other player or NPC) - loses Faith. If a player was an innocent  he will become a criminal instantly.
 Player cannot drop below -1000 Faith when doing minor crimes. Only killing innocents can make him drop below this level.
 Faith from -10,000 up to -1000 represent a murderer (aka PK). These players have **red **nicknames.
 Murderers (PKs) have reduced rates of Faith recovery. Takes few hours to recover for a single kill.
 If a murderer (PK) drops its Faith up to maximum level which is -10,000 Faith - then Faith recovery drops to 0.
 Player lose Faith for crimes such as: hitting innocents, killing innocents, looting innocents, stealing from innocents, etc.
 Everyone (including other criminals or innocents) may freely attack criminals (gray) players and murderers (red) players. No faith penalties. Including within the town.
 Guards do NOT auto attack criminals (gray) players by default. However, NPC or Players may call guards for help typing in to the chat something like "Guards" or "guards" or "guards!!!" , etc.. and if there is a Guard around - he will come and start attacking all the criminals/reds around you.
 Guards DO attack murderers(reds) by default, without a need to call for their help.
 Player's pets fully represent the owner's Faith level. If innocent tame a horse - the horse become an innocent ("blue") , etc. 
 If a pet loses Faith (like attacking an innocent) - the owner of the pet gets 100% of Faith loss for his pet.
 All the NPC talk differently to innocents, criminals and murderers. Innocent (blue) NPC reject talking with a murderer player (red) and run away, screaming insults and calling guards.
 New world object added - "**Shrine** statue".  Usually placed in churchs or squares or graveyards. All players may interact with the shrine to start ~30 sec cast "Praying" that has a 5% chance to bless a player and increase his Faith by +500. This works for -10,000 murderers as well.
 Praying also has a chance to train Intelligence (INT) stat.


P.s. In next release, players will be getting unique in-game Titles, bonuses and abilities based on their Faith level.

notes.title: Patch v.0.1.4.4
notes.notes:
Weight logic added to the game.
Every single item now has its own weight measured in kilograms. 

 Total weight is a summary of all the items in Inventory and currently equipped on the character.
 Character by default has 10 kg of maximum weight.
 Every +1 STR adds 0.5kg of maximum weight that character can carry. 150 of STR provides overall 10kg + 150/2 = 85 kg of maximum weight.
 Once the limit reached, you still can get more items but you get a "Overweight" debuff that slows your character significantly and constantly drains the Stamina.
 You cannot pickup new items once you reach ~150% of your maximum Total Weight.


New combat skill - Archery.
Now players can equip bows to do range damage. Higher skill increases damage and crit chance as well as opens new Archery abilities.

 Inherits all the logics as with hold-to-attack logic.
 Dexterity skill increases attack speed while Strength increases damage done.
 To shoot, a player needs an ammo (arrows for bows, bolts for crossbows, etc). One shot consumes 1 ammo accordingly.
 Quiver automatically equipped when player is equipped with a bow type of weapon. Arrows in the quiver visually represent if you have ammo or not. If no ammo left - the quiver will be empty as well.
 New ability added: "Eagle Eye - Enhances your vision, allowing you to see distant targets with incredible clarity and precision while aiming with ranged weapons. Higher skill makes aiming faster." Requires 30% of Archery.
 New ability added: " Elven Quickdraw - Significantly boosts your ranged attacking speed." Requires 40% of Archery.

notes.title: Patch v.0.1.4.3
notes.notes:
Combat reworked: Hold-to-attack implementation.
Now you need to hold the attack hotkey and release button when you want the swing landing.


 Getting hit from all sources will interrupt the holding process of your attack.
 Only "damaging part" of your weapon does damage. Example: The wooden part of a spear would not cause damage, but if the iron tip strikes the target, it would trigger harm to the target.
 If you hold an attack longer - you hit harder (with maximum limit per weapon type and Dexterity stat). No GUI tooltip, but player makes relevant sound if hit executed on its maximum hold power.
 You lose Stamina while holding an attack, preventing player constantly stay in attacking state. Heavier weapons consumes more Stamina.
 New hotkey added that would cancel your attack without losing Stamina and instant animation. That would allow you change the direction of your next attack that increases overall combat potential.
 If your hit got parried/deflected/blocked, then you get some quick animation penalty, but enough time for opponent to retaliate.



Items durability implemented.
Now when you use an item - it will be loosing it's durability and eventually become unusable/unequipable unless repaired. Destroyable items help a lot to keep the economic up and make Crafter's life reacher! 


 There are few durability states now: Pristine, Worn, Damaged, Ruined.
 "Ruined" items cannot be used in any way.
 If the item got ruined while equipped - it will be automatically unequipped to the inventory. If no slots available - it will be dropped on the ground.
 Currently you can repair any metal item (Weapons, armor, etc that made of metal) using the Blacksmithing skill. Repair cost is just 1 ingot of the metal that item made of. During repair, based on the Blacksmithing skill level - there is a chance to completely destroy an item.
 "Damaged" weapons do reduced damage.
 Now NPCs drop "Damaged/Worn" items more often than "Pristine".
 While crafting an item, you always get "Pristine" durability.
 Smelting "Ruined" item brings as same amount of ingots as "Pristine", etc.
 All the items have different level of total durability capacity.
 Weapons lose extra durability when colliding with other weapons. Stronger/heavier weapon takes less durability loss.
 Any peace of equipment (shields, armors, weapons, etc) may be one-shot destroyed, if hit by enormous damage (Don't try using low tier shield to block a hit from Mountain Troll or Balrog, etc..). 
 Armor (protection value) of an item - reduces durability loss. That makes higher tier metals more durable.

notes.title: Patch v.0.1.4.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41859553/b36bd105bbcb27cd57597876a1d4c40ddb757b18.jpg
Successfully migrated to the well-known cloud database.

Now all your data is stored on the most secured DB that exists nowadays. You may freely enjoy the game, knowing that there is zero chance that your progress and data will be lost. Now we also have hourly database backups that each would be stored for many months. This would allow us to do necessary investigations, maintenances, improvements, etc.
Please note that, for the testing purposes only, during next playtest I'll be on purpose restart the server (takes ~5 min) every few hours to test how the cloud DB save/load works.


Steam authentication.

Starting from this version - no need to keep your logins/passwords and filling up boring registration forms.
We officially moved all the authentication to the Steam! To play, you just click the "play" button on Steam and in a moment you are in the game, already logged in.
Please note that Steam (VAC) also applies so cheaters will get punished severely.

notes.title: Patch v.0.1.4.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41859553/23affa2eba01cb062c03fe23ac9eefbf1a23b8ce.jpg

Successfully migrated from Unity 2019 to Unity 6.
Unity 6 offers enhanced performance, optimization, and support compared to previously used Unity 2019.
This brings tons of different improvements like.

All the values successfully moved to the server side.
That means it is technically impossible to change numbers (gold amount, stats, skills, etc...) using any kind of hack software! 

The Anti-cheat system has been enabled.
Server automatically detects and prevents all the hacks that a player tries to exploit. In addition, the system marks player's account with required info about the event. I will evaluate this feature during the next playtest and planning enabling "automatic bans" based on this data.
P.s. Say good bye to cheating in Legendarium!

notes.title: Pre-Alpha v0.1.2 Update
notes.notes:
Feb 26 of 2023, we performed "Pre-Alpha v0.1.2 Closed test" where players were able to explore the start location (W.I.P.). They could fight each other or even kill any NPC they see.

What's new in v0.1.2:
- Added skills Animal Taming, Swordsmanship, Slashing
- Added tamable animals such as Horses and Mustangs
- All other animals became tamable
- New spells added: 
 
  Blink - teleport for short distance 
  Magic Arrow - instant cast of offensive spell, low damage but fast enough
  Morning Star - The buff that allows you to see in the dark

- New NPC added: Mountain Troll
